_doc: setViewNear's own check (specification 003 T004): one view of each kind of element nearest the town's centre, each found by the core and printed: a walker and a vehicle (the clock run for 10 s so traffic is out, then stopped), a lamp, a pole and a sign of the street under that vehicle, the tallest building's foot; a kind with none there fails the plan. Near (40 px a metre) from 55 degrees for the lamp and the pole and from above (75) for the walker, who stands at a tower's foot, all between the centre's towers (from 20-25 degrees a tower hid them), mid (20) and oblique for the vehicle and the sign, far (8) for the building; by day.
